subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 485 (TRF(II)-21). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: STF (source transfer), INFO-SOLD (information solidification) and TRS (transition). From STF: EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From EXP-CONT-1: C-RH (composite research). From INFO-SOLD: C-CONT (composite continuance) and TH-CONT-IMP. From TH-CONT-IMP: BIA (bi-aitional). From TRS: P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From P-PROG: ECO-DY (economic dynamics).
